rating.comments: The first message is the pasted task question and was ignored. The student gives one brief reason, "because the density higer", which is a single justification with no chain or check. The student asks content questions such as "why so", "what makes the difference" and "why does is it travel faster in water", but the last one mostly repeats the original question, so knowledge building is limited. Only one reason is offered across four student messages, and no AI messages are present, so effort is rated moderate.
